_file.description: Same shape as reference_designs.json (usage -> pin/function entries, one top-level entry per board), but for a manufacturer's own custom pin layout that has no Rotorflight reference design behind it at all -- kept in its own file, separate from reference_designs.json, because that file is overwritten wholesale by whatever reference_design_source.js fetches live from rotorflight/rotorflight-configurator's own reference_designs.json on GitHub; an entry only ever added locally here would otherwise vanish the moment that fetch succeeds. Each entry is keyed by the board's own reported name (FC.CONFIG.boardName), matched case-insensitively and as a *prefix* (see reference_design_labels.js's findUsages), not a design family -- "FLYDRAGON_PRO" here matches a real board reporting "FLYDRAGON_PRO42688" (the trailing digits are a specific MCU/revision code, not part of the product-line name). Supplied directly by the manufacturer -- its Rear port pins only (ESC/RPM/TAIL/CH1-3/TX2/RX2/AUX); its Expansion and GPS port pins aren't documented here yet, since no default functionality was given for them.
